Sessions / Session 02 Run Guide

Session 02 — Run Guide: Conflict is a Surety

4–6 hours. Opens mid-combat. Ends wherever the party sets course.

Scripted first act (finish the fight, meet Grigori, explore the ship), then full sandbox. By the end of Scene 5 the party should understand what the ship needs to run, which crew might stay, and why sailing straight for Tidefall is a risk.

State at Open

WhoStatusKey Numbers
Barnaby RookUnharmed. Alone. Pistols fired. Cornered Wolf active.120 HP · AC 17 · 4-PC: drop to 110 HP
Beaumont SelIn the fight. 3 healing potions to deliver via Kalowe Maneuver.Full statblock on his page
Geoffrey DravesFighting with the party. Rook can call him out once — free action, DC 12 Wis save; fail = frozen one round.11 HP · AC 12
Shepherd GrigoriBelow deck. Not coming up. Waiting for the fight to end.CR 19 — not a combat encounter

Scene Order

DM Note

Sequence: Rook → Deck Confrontation → Grigori → Ship → Course → Travel. Session opens mid-combat — initiative was already rolled at end of Session 01. No pre-combat beat. The Bell (Call to Arms) happens inside Round 3, not before it.

SceneFileTime
1 — The Rook ResolutionScene 01 — Rook Final30–60 min
2 — Deck ConfrontationScene 02b (Beaumont/stowaways)5–15 min
3 — Below Deck: GrigoriScene 03 — Grigori20–40 min
4 — The ShipShip exploration + crew + bastion45–75 min
5 — Set CourseThree options; sandbox opens10–20 min
6 — TravelCentral Strait eventsRemaining time

Ship Exploration — Key Beats

Loot total: ~587 gp coin/goods + Mira’s Blade, 2× potion of greater healing, 1× potion of water breathing, 1× potion of healing.

LocationContents
Medic’s cabinet2 healer’s kits, 1 healing potion, 1 greater healing potion
Captain’s cabin (DC 15 locked chest)45 gp, papers, 1 greater healing potion, 1 potion of water breathing
Hidden stash under bunk (DC 13 Investigation)110 gp + 2 garnets
Seized crate 1~97 gp goods, pendant engraved “For Mira, from the sea”
Seized crate 22 flintlocks, Mira’s Blade (+1 shortsword), 20 Grung tincture vials (~100 gp black market) — Jean-Claude recognizes the prep method
Locked cargo crate (DC 14)150 gp, folded map to “Galewall anchorage”
DM Note

Before individual shares, pull ~120 gp into a ship’s fund. Crew wages run ~36 gp/month. Repainting the Crown registry costs 75 gp at Kalowe or 150 gp at Tidefall. If nobody raises this, Geoffrey will — quietly, once.

Bastion slots: Boarding Locker = Weapons Locker (installed). Chart Table = Chart Archive (installed). Two slots open. Don’t announce as a rules beat — let them discover what they already have.

Crew Retention

Each defaults to leaving at next port. What changes the math:

CrewCondition to Stay
HolstAsk a real question about the hull, not the speed
WoutersGive him a formal title; he will write it down
AlysAcknowledge the Surgeon post and the Surgeon’s Berth
Old FaasAsk about the rigging, listen to all twelve minutes
NoorName an interesting destination
ThunkAsk anything about the guns or powder
